Definition: of uncertain affinity; gain (pecuniary or genitive case):--gain, lucre.
BiblicalUsage: Kerdos means gain, profit, lucre. Philippians 1:21 says, for to me to live is Christ, and to die is gain. Philippians 3:7 says, what things were gain to me, those I counted loss for Christ. Titus 1:11 warns of men subverting whole houses, teaching things which they ought not, for filthy lucre's sake.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe gain is holy when it is Christ and filthy when it is money: Paul counted death gain because living was Christ. I hold that the teachers who sell the gospel for lucre have their gain and their judgment both.
